about: Fishing places (docs/fishing.md): the spots the angler's journal names, the rowing boat at the pier, the kitchens that buy fish. Each takes its place from Content/City/city_plan.json by its plan id when the plan has it (ue, cm), else from its own ue. A spot is a stretch: within radius of the segment from a to b (offsets from the plan point, cm); the first that holds the hero's feet names the catch.
